Daily digest created for Alex Parent

1. CR Weekly eNews Feb 11, 2026: Enjoy the Long Weekend!

Posted by Dana Whitfield on Wednesday, Feb 11 at 5:15 PM in Cedar Ridge School

CR Weekly eNews

February 11, 2026

Principal's Message

Good Evening CR Families!

Thank you to all of the families that supported REF's Fuel the Future. Our RSD schools collectively raised almost $110,00. I will share final numbers for our school as soon as I have the update. We appreciate all of your support to our school programs and specials.

Reminder that February 12-16th is President's Weekend. There is no school tomorrow, Friday or next Monday. Enjoy your five day weekend!

Our teachers and staff will be spending time together tomorrow to learn about updates to our math curriculum & focus on student writing!

There were quite a few celebrations in classes today. Please check your child's backpack for uneaten treats and goodies.

Parent Survey

We are currently at 5% participation! Our goal is 75%! Please take a (few) minute to give us feedback as a school and district and complete the Youth Truth Survey. YouthTruth, a nonprofit organization that supports hundreds of schools and districts across the country, conducts an anonymous survey on our behalf.

Please take the survey before it closes at midnight on February 27 by clicking this link: survey.example.org/rsdfamily26.

It's a great day to be a Falcon!

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield, Principal

CR Special Announcement!

Please join me in recognizing and celebrating our Cedar Ridge Teacher of the Year and Staff Member of the Year!

Mark Ellison - 4th Grade Teacher

Many of you with older students know Mr. Ellison. A talented, experienced educator, he strives to get to know his students each and every year, and instill in them all the necessary learning, but especially a love of reading.

Rosa Delgado - Attendance Clerk & Campus Supervisor

If your child has ever been sick, absent or tardy, you have likely interacted with Ms. Rosa. She is detail-oriented, attentive, patient and above all, kind.

Incoming 6th Grade - Welcome to RI!

5th grade parents should have received an email from RI Principal Kevin Marsh on Sunday evening.

Welcome New Ranger Families!

We are excited to welcome our incoming Class of 2026–2027 students & families to Riverside Intermediate. Middle school is a big step, and while it can come with a few nerves, our goal is simple: Help your child feel confident, supported, and genuinely excited to become a Ranger. It is time to be BRAVE!

As you start looking ahead to spring, we want to share a few important opportunities to get connected with RI. A good place to start is OUR WEBSITE. In April, our administrative and counseling team will be visiting Cedar Ridge students! These visits give us a chance to preview the RI experience and get students excited about middle school. We are scheduled to visit Cedar Ridge on April 14 at 1:45 pm.

Parents are invited to a parent-only informational night April 9 from 6:30–7:30 pm in the RI gym. Learn about life at Riverside Intermediate, ask questions, and get a sense of what the next three years will look like. Our PTA will be there to share how to stay involved and connected.

Because your child is already enrolled in a RSD elementary school, there is nothing you need to do to enroll or register. Students will automatically transition to RI. Sixth grade schedules are mostly predetermined, so there is not a traditional class selection process, with just a couple of exceptions that we will explain on April 9.

The unofficial (and my favorite) kickoff to the RI experience happens on May 21 during our annual Open House. From 6:30 - 8:00 pm, families are invited to walk the campus, visit classrooms, and see firsthand what learning looks like at RI. This is a great opportunity for both you and your child to experience the school together.

After spending years at your neighborhood elementary school, we know the transition to middle school can feel like a big leap, for students and parents alike. Please know that you are not doing this alone.

Welcome to Riverside Intermediate.
Welcome to the Ranger family.

Kevin Marsh
